title: Amortised adaptive importance sampling
abstract: arXiv:2610.16736v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Monte Carlo sampling algorithms aim to produce samples from a target distribution with a given unnormalised probability density function. The high cost of running Monte Carlo algorithms, with many simulation steps or particles needed to obtain a good empirical approximation to the target, can be reduced by introducing learnable components into the sampler -- a form of amortisation. Once these components are trained, amortised samplers can produce high-quality samples with less computation at sampling time than training-free algorithms would require. We propose an amortised sampler built upon the framework of adaptive importance sampling -- a hierarchical importance sampling procedure where the proposal is iteratively adapted. Our amortised adaptive importance sampling algorithm fits a lightweight neural network that adapts the proposal using information obtained over the course of sampling. translated_title: 摊销式自适应重要性采样
translated_abstract: 蒙特卡洛采样算法旨在从具有给定非归一化概率密度函数的目标分布中生成样本。运行蒙特卡洛算法的高昂成本——需要许多模拟步骤或大量粒子才能对目标获得良好的经验近似——可以通过在采样器中引入可学习组件来降低，这是一种摊销形式。一旦这些组件训练完成，摊销采样器便可在采样阶段以比免训练算法所需更少的计算量生成高质量样本。我们提出了一种建立在自适应重要性采样框架之上的摊销采样器——自适应重要性采样是一种分层重要性采样过程，其中提议分布被迭代地调整。我们的摊销自适应重要性采样算法拟合一个轻量级神经网络，该网络利用采样过程中获得的信息来调整提议分布。通过在许多不同的目标分布上训练我们的采样器（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种摊销式自适应重要性采样算法，通过拟合轻量级神经网络利用采样过程中的信息迭代调整提议分布，从而在训练完成后以更少的计算量生成高质量样本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an amortised adaptive importance sampling algorithm that fits a lightweight neural network to iteratively adapt the proposal distribution using information gathered during sampling, enabling high-quality sample generation with reduced computation at sampling time.
